notes: MiniMax-M3 is the pinned shared model (spec §12.1, answered 2026-09-03): every agent reaches it on the same key, freecode natively and the others through MiniMax's Anthropic-compatible endpoint. `--agent danger` is the parity setting, not a shortcut — `build` denies every write headlessly (permission/prompt.ts). Sessions and memory still land in ~/.freecode and carry between trials; the container (Phase 1) is what fixes that.
